correctness.rationale: The valuation-layer rule gives adjacency exactly when i+j>=ell. The m-by-m matrix H with that zero-nonzero pattern is nonsingular after column reversal, and its layer blow-up A=P^T H P has rank m=ell-1 and exactly the graph's off-diagonal pattern. Thus M>=N-(ell-1). Leaving one white representative in each layer gives a forcing sequence x_i -> u_{ell-i} for i=1,...,ell-2, then u_{ell-1}->u_1, so Z<=N-(ell-1). The universal inequality M<=Z forces equality. The q=2, ell=2 graph K1 is checked separately. The packaged verifier confirms exact ranks and exhaustive small cases.

value.rationale: The result identifies the finite chain ring's nilpotency length directly from a graph inverse-eigenvalue invariant: mr(Gamma(R))=ell-1 outside one boundary. It also proves exact equality Z=M for the entire family using explicit algebraically motivated constructions. This is a natural structural invariant of the graph, not a small numerical case or a restatement of adjacency spectrum.
